sentences.text: Coelosuchus was a reptile slightly over one meter in length.
Williston first described the genus in 1906, naming the type species Coelosuchus reedii.
This animal belongs to the family Goniopholididae within the group of goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylians.
Fossils from the Graneros Shale of the Benton Group in Wyoming date to the Cenomanian age, between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago.
